title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brady Christensen to have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Brady Christensen will have his 21-day window opened this week.
items.impact: Christensen will have the next few weeks to officially be activated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) could have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said WR Xavier Legette could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Legette still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Chiefs D/ST fails to force turnover in Week 8
items.desc: The Chiefs' defense allowed 28 points and 294 total yards. while recording one sack in Kansas City's Week 8 loss to the Broncos.
items.impact: Kansas City held Denver to 294 yards, but the defense failed to force a turnover and allowed 15 points in the fourth quarter. Jonah Coleman scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. One sack and zero takeaways resulted in a poor fantasy day for the Chiefs D/ST.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Harrison Butker makes one field goal in Week 8
items.desc: Harrison Butker made one of his two field-goal attempts and all three extra-point attempts in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8 as well.
items.impact: Butker connected from 45 yards before halftime before missing from 54 yards in the fourth quarter. The miss proved costly in a four-point loss. Still, Kansas City's offense continues to provide Butker with enough scoring opportunities to keep him in fantasy lineups.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks (core) could have practice window opened this week
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said RB Jonathon Brooks could have his practice window opened this week.
items.impact: Canales added that Brooks still has some things he needs to clear recovery-wise. His status will need to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Noah Gray scores touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Noah Gray caught both of his targets for 15 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Gray caught a four-yard touchdown for Kansas City's final score of the game. That said, he had two targets compared to seven for Travis Kelce. Gray needs touchdowns to provide fantasy value as long as Kelce is healthy.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Travis Kelce records 67 receiving yards in Week 8
items.desc: Travis Kelce caught five of seven targets for 67 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Kelce finished second on the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards, including a 32-yard reception. Noah Gray caught Kansas City's tight end touchdown, but Kelce had seven targets compared to two for Gray. Nothing changed here. Kelce remains a TE1.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Xavier Worthy held to 13 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Xavier Worthy caught three of six targets for 13 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Worthy had six targets but averaged 4.3 yards per reception. He has 13 targets over his last two games, so opportunities aren't necessarily the problem. The production is. Worthy has 86 receiving yards over that stretch and remains a volatile fantasy option.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) trending in the right direction
items.desc: Panthers head coach Dave Canales said OLB Jaelan Phillips is trending in the right direction.
items.impact: Phillips did not play in last Thursday's loss against the Packers. He is considered day-to-day.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Rashee Rice scores touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Rashee Rice caught seven of eight targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Rice led Kansas City with eight targets and seven receptions. He also caught an 11-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Rice averaged just 7.6 yards per reception, but that's secondary to the usage. He remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Emmett Johnson explodes for 143 yards, touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Emmett Johnson rushed once for 15 yards while catching all five of his targets for 128 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Johnson turned a Patrick Mahomes pass into a 73-yard touchdown and finished with 143 total yards on six touches. So, is there a changing of the guard in Kansas City's backfield? No. Kenneth Walker III had 25 touches compared to six for Johnson. That said, 143 yards on six touches should earn Johnson more opportunities moving forward.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Kenneth Walker III totals 84 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III rushed 21 times for 69 yards while catching four of five targets for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Walker had 25 touches and accounted for 21 of Kansas City's 24 rushing attempts. That's the good. The bad? He averaged 3.3 yards per carry and failed to score. The workload is enough to keep Walker in fantasy lineups even when the production isn't there.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: KhaDarel Hodge signs with 49ers practice squad
items.desc: The 49ers signed WR and special teams ace KhaDarel Hodge to the practice squad.
items.impact: Hodge will add depth at wide receiver and on special teams for San Francisco.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Patrick Mahomes throws three touchdowns in Week 8
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns while rushing twice for six yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
items.impact: Mahomes threw touchdowns to Rashee Rice, Emmett Johnson, and Noah Gray without turning the ball over. He also surpassed 300 passing yards for the first time this season. After failing to throw a touchdown against the Chargers in Week 6, Mahomes returned to QB1 production against Denver. He's back.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Broncos D/ST allows 399 yards in Week 8
items.desc: The Broncos' defense allowed 24 points and 399 total yards while recording two sacks in Denver's 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Patrick Mahomes threw for 321 yards and three touchdowns, while Denver failed to force a turnover. So, this wasn't a productive fantasy day. That said, the Broncos held Kansas City scoreless in the fourth quarter and stopped the Chiefs at the one-yard line to end the game. Denver remains one of the better defenses in football despite the lack of fantasy production Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Will Lee III (hamstring) day-to-day
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said CB Will Lee III is day-to-day with a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Lee suffered the injury in Week 8's loss against the Packers. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Wil Lutz makes two field goals in Week 8
items.desc: Wil Lutz made both of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point attempts in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Lutz connected from 39 and 45 yards. He has now made five field goals over the last two games as Denver's offense has scored 58 points. The scoring opportunities are there for Lutz.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Evan Engram held without a catch in Week 8
items.desc: Evan Engram failed to catch any of his three targets in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Engram had two receiving yards in Week 7. He followed that performance with zero catches Sunday. Nate Adkins, meanwhile, caught a touchdown. Engram simply isn't producing enough to enter fantasy lineups.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. totals 29 yards in Week 8
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. caught two of three targets for 10 yards while rushing twice for 19 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Mims had five touches, but those opportunities resulted in 29 total yards. He has just five targets over the last two games. Denver continues to manufacture touches for Mims, but there isn't enough volume for fantasy managers to rely on him.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
items.desc: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jaylen Waddle scores touchdown in Week 8
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Waddle scored from one yard out in the second quarter and caught the two-point conversion that cut Kansas City's lead to three in the fourth quarter. He also led Denver's wide receivers with six targets. The yardage wasn't there, but Waddle has separated himself from Courtland Sutton and Marvin Mims Jr. as the Broncos wide receiver to start in fantasy.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: J.K. Dobbins held to 13 yards in Week 8
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Jonah Coleman totals 104 yards, scores in Week 8
items.desc: Jonah Coleman rushed 11 times for 41 yards and one touchdown, while catching four of five targets for 63 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.

items.author: Joshua Kellem
items.title: Bo Nix throws two touchdowns in Week 8
items.desc: Bo Nix completed 20 of 32 passes for 222 yards and two touchdowns, while rushing three times for four yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
items.impact: Nix threw touchdowns to Jaylen Waddle and Nate Adkins without turning the ball over. The Broncos quarterback didn't offer much on the ground, but he has now thrown four touchdowns and zero interceptions over his last two games. Nix gets the Panthers in Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said CB Mansoor Delane is considered day-to-day.
items.impact: Delane did not play in Sunday's loss against the Broncos. "It's just a matter of it being strong enough to get out there," Reid said of Delane's right shoulder injury. "There's a chance that he'll be able to get himself out there this week. Again, it's just how strong it is. It's going to be a day-to-day thing."

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zachariah Branch (hamstring) ruled out for Week 9
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Zachariah Branch has a hamstring injury and will not play in Week 9 against the Falcons.
items.impact: Branch is considered to be week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Samson Ebukam (hamstring) ruled out for Week 9
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Samson Ebukam has a hamstring injury and will not play in Week 9 against the Falcons.
items.impact: Ebukam is considered week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cashius Howell (wrist) likely headed to IR
items.desc: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Cashius Howell is likely headed to injured reserve.
items.impact: Howell is dealing with a wrist injury. He would miss at least the next four weeks if he is officially placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Turner II day-to-day with heel injury
items.desc: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said CB DJ Turner II is day-to-day with a heel injury.
items.impact: Turner's status is up in the air heading into Week 9.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Miami Dolphins D/ST manage three sacks in loss to Patriots
items.desc: The Miami Dolphins D/ST managed to get three sacks and a fumble recovery against the Patriots in their 24-19 loss on Sunday, but couldn't eke out the win.
items.impact: The defense did well in the first half, holding the Patriots to a measly three points while the offense built a 10 point lead. That came undone in the second half, however, as the Patriots were able to put up three touchdowns: two passing strikes and a rushing score by Drake Maye. It was a tough loss for the young team, and they have a tall task agaisnt them next week against the Lions.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Zane Gonzalez goes for seven kicking points in loss to Patriots
items.desc: Zane Gonzalez hit his only PAT and two of his three field goal attempts in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Gonzalez had a nice 52-yard kick in this game, but could have had a bigger day had he connected on a 43-yard attempt. He's been fine so far in his two games, but lacks much upside with the offense being a bit lackluster.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) could practice Wednesday, status uncertain
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) could practice this week, but the Saints will determine his status on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tyson hasn't practiced or played yet since the season started, but it looks like he is clos to returning. They haven't fully committed to his return this week, but don't be surprised if he at least gets back on the practice field.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Yaya Diaby (knee) has sprained MCL, expected to miss a couple of weeks
items.desc: Yaya Diaby (knee) has a Grade 2 MCL sprain and is expected to miss a couple of weeks, but not extended time.
items.impact: Diaby went down with an injury in the Bucs win over Atlanta, and had an MRI today to determine the extent. And while he will miss time, it's good that it's nothing incredibly serious or season-ending.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mack Hollins (calf) could return to practice this week
items.desc: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said WR Mack Hollins could return to practice this week.
items.impact: Hollins is eligible to come off injured reserve starting this week. He has been sidelined with a calf injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) hopeful to practice this week
items.desc: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said "we'll see how he progresses" when asked if A.J. Brown will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Brown did not play in Sunday's win over the Dolphins. He remains up in the air heading into Week 9.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) without update on status
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans did not have an update on the status of Jalen Pitre.
items.impact: Pitre was injured heading into the bye week. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) without update on status
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans did not have an update on the status of Reed Blankenship.
items.impact: Blankenship was injured heading into the bye week. He will need to be monitored in practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) without update on status
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans did not have an update on the status of RB David Montgomery.
items.impact: The Texans are coming out of their bye week. Montgomery will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deuce Vaughn released by Texans
items.desc: The Texans released RB Deuce Vaughn.
items.impact: Vaughn will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joshua Pitsenberger signs with Texans
items.desc: The Texans signed Joshua Pitsenberger.
items.impact: Pitsenberger will add depth in the backfield for Houston.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaden Crumedy released by Texans
items.desc: The Texans released Jaden Crumedy.
items.impact: Crumedy will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
items.desc: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
items.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) hopeful to return in Week 10
items.desc: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr said he hopes to be back after the bye week and has started running.
items.impact: Pittman said the injury began as plantar fasciitis but turned into something else with his foot. He was never expected to require surgery.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten gashes Colts in Week 8 rout
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten went for 104 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries, adding in two receptions for 55 yards and another score in Sunday's 42-7 blowout of the Colts.
items.impact: Tuten turned in the first 100-yard rushing performance of his career on Sunday while also setting a new personal best in receiving yards. The second-year speedster has now scored twice in both of the Jaguars' last two games and is up to six total touchdowns - three rushing, three receiving - for the campaign. Tuten is quickly inserting himself among the league's most potent dual-threat weapons at his position, as he's averaging nearly 18 touches and over 96 yards of offense per game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) expected to return in Week 9
items.desc: Jets RB Breece Hall is expected to return in Week 9 against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Hall was limited in practice all week last week and listed as questionable before he was limited. He should have another week of practice before he is expected to return on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Huntley to miss extended time with turf toe injury
items.desc: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley is expected to miss "extended time" after suffering a turf toe injury in Week 8's loss to the Bills.
items.impact: Huntley will likely miss multiple weeks as a result. With Lamar Jackson undergoing surgery, rookie UDFA Joe Fagnano is currently the lone healthy quarterback for Baltimore. It is unclear if the Ravens will make a move at the position.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chris Rodriguez hits paydirt in Week 8 win
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on six carries, adding in a 17-yard reception in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Rodriguez continues to be a solid change-of-pace back for the Jaguars. The fourth-year ball carrier scored his third touchdown of the season in the third quarter of this contest, sprinting from 28 yards out for his longest gain of the campaign to date. Rodriguez is averaging 4.6 yards on his 45 carries so far this season and should be considered a top-tier handcuff.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Parker Washington catches just one pass in Week 8
items.desc: Parker Washington caught 1-of-2 targets for 16 yards and gained 10 yards on one carry in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
items.impact: This was not the game fantasy managers expected from Washington on Sunday, but the Jaguars just didn't need to throw the ball much in order to blow out the struggling Colts. Washington's stat lines have been all over the place the last few games, but he is still the top receiving option on a high-powered offense that spreads the ball around.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jakobi Meyers finishes with a pair of receptions in Week 8
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
items.impact: Meyers actually led the Jaguars in targets on Sunday, as Trevor Lawrence and backup Quinn Ewers only put the ball in the air a combined 17 times. The Jaguars just did not need to sling it around to vanquish the Colts. Meyers has now caught two or fewer passes in 4-of-7 games so far this season, but he's still a significant piece of a high-powered offense.
